evidence: The ZnO films were deposited at temperatures of 150 – 200 °C using alternating exposures to diethyl zinc (DEZ, Aldrich) and deionized water with exposure times of 90 s and purge times of 270 s between reactant exposures. Ultrahigh purity (99.999%) nitrogen carrier gas was used at a flow rate of 360 sccm and a pressure of 133 Pa.
